newsitem.title: UK: SocGen launches five bond unit trusts.
newsitem.headline: SocGen launches five bond unit trusts.

text.p: Societe Generale Asset Management said Tuesday it has launched a series of unit trusts which invest in high-grade French bonds.
Called SGAM Premiere, the series comprises five unit trusts which track the French yield curve from overnight rates to ten years, Societe Generale said in a statement.

"These products, which have been designed to meet the needs of institutional investors, companies and non-profit making associations, which are seeking a higher yield than is possible on the Paris money market," SGAM said.
The unit trusts will be actively managed and may deviate by as much as 20 percent from the benchmark.
The unit trusts are as follows:
-- SGAM Premiere Jour, a money-market fund
-- SGAM Premiere Associa, a high-yield treasury unit trust
-- SGAM Premiere 3-5 Ans, a bond-based investment fund
-- SGAM Premiere 5-7 Ans, a bond-based investment fund
-- SGAM Premiere 7-10 Ans, a bond-based unit trust.
Standard & Poor's has given the unit trusts a AAA rating.
